name: Gladly
description: Gladly is a radically personal customer service (helpdesk/CX) platform that unifies conversations across channels around a single customer timeline for contact center agents.
gating_notes: Gladly has no public self-serve signup or pricing page (enterprise contact-sales model, ~$150-210/agent/month per third-party pricing aggregators). Within an existing paid account, only users granted the 'API User' role by an admin (Settings > Users) can generate an API token (Settings > App Developer Tools > API Tokens); token generation itself takes ~15 min but requires an admin-provisioned enterprise account first.
mcp_notes: No official Gladly-built MCP server found in its developer docs. Only third-party/unofficial offerings exist, e.g. StackOne advertises a Gladly MCP connector with 65 pre-built actions, but this is not published or endorsed by Gladly itself.
